correctness.rationale: The theorem fixes even n≥6 and labelled 0/1/2/3 singleton assignments. Published minimum weights are taken from the primary 2026 theorem, not inferred from numerical data. Every zero support is independent with at most one zero per twisted-strip column; at optimum this leaves 0, 1 or 2 empty columns. The triangle-chain lemma gives six colourings for each nonempty run; the distinct two-run matchings contribute 36, 54 or zero according to residue compatibility, with all orientations counted. The six-case support census simplifies to the four residue formulas. Standalone support/constraint-graph enumeration checks all even n from 6 through 42; independent four-label enumeration checks n=6,8,10. Finite checks are supplementary, not proof of infinite cases.
